label: NEAR circulating market cap
methodology: CoinGecko circulating market cap = price x CoinGecko circulating supply. Free-tier data can lag a few minutes.

label: NEAR price
methodology: CoinGecko aggregated spot price.

label: NEAR circulating supply (CoinGecko)
methodology: CoinGecko circulating supply figure; definitions differ by provider.

label: Solana circulating market cap
methodology: CoinGecko circulating market cap = price x CoinGecko circulating supply. Free-tier data can lag a few minutes.

label: Sui circulating market cap
methodology: CoinGecko circulating market cap = price x CoinGecko circulating supply. Free-tier data can lag a few minutes.

label: Avalanche circulating market cap
methodology: CoinGecko circulating market cap = price x CoinGecko circulating supply. Free-tier data can lag a few minutes.

label: NEAR market cap change, trailing 365 days
methodology: Percent change between the first and last daily market cap in CoinGecko's 365-day history.

label: NEAR Intents swap volume, 90 days
transform: sum of daily values over 90 days ending 2026-11-10
methodology: DefiLlama near-intents DEX adapter, daily swap volume in USD.

label: NEAR Intents swap volume, prior 90 days
transform: sum of daily values over 90 days ending 2026-08-12
methodology: Same adapter, the 90 days immediately before the current window.

label: NEAR Intents gross fees, 90 days
transform: sum of daily values over 90 days ending 2026-11-10
methodology: DefiLlama definition: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators.

label: NEAR Intents gross fees, prior 90 days
transform: sum of daily values over 90 days ending 2026-08-12
methodology: DefiLlama definition: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators.

label: NEAR Intents captured revenue, 90 days
transform: sum of daily values over 90 days ending 2026-11-10
methodology: DefiLlama definition: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded.

label: NEAR Intents captured revenue, prior 90 days
transform: sum of daily values over 90 days ending 2026-08-12
methodology: DefiLlama definition: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded.

label: Revenue DefiLlama classifies as buybacks, 90 days
transform: sum of daily values over 90 days ending 2026-11-10
methodology: DefiLlama definition: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.

label: NEAR Intents annualized volume (V)
methodology: Run rate: trailing 90-day volume scaled to a year. Assumes the recent 90 days persist; it is not a forecast.

label: Volume change, last 90 days vs prior 90 days
methodology: Matched consecutive 90-day windows from the same adapter.

label: Effective gross fee rate (f)
methodology: Gross fees (protocol + distributor fees) divided by volume over the same 90 days and the same DefiLlama protocol scope.

label: Effective gross fee rate, prior 90 days
methodology: Same definition, prior window. Compare with INT-FEE-RATE to see fee compression or expansion.

label: Protocol capture of gross fees (c)
methodology: NEAR-captured revenue (swept to NEAR revenue wallets) divided by gross fees. The remainder goes to solvers and distribution partners.

label: Protocol capture of gross fees, prior 90 days
methodology: Same definition as INT-CAPTURE, prior window.

label: NEAR-captured revenue per dollar of volume (f x c)
methodology: Captured revenue divided by volume over the same window: how much of each swapped dollar NEAR keeps.

label: NEAR-captured revenue per dollar of volume, prior 90 days
methodology: Same definition, prior window. A falling take rate while volume grows means value capture lags activity.

label: Share of captured revenue classified as buybacks (b)
methodology: DefiLlama holders revenue divided by captured revenue over the same window.
notes: Depends on DefiLlama's classification of revenue as holders revenue; not an onchain-verified allocation policy and not guaranteed to continue.

label: NEAR Intents captured revenue, annualized
methodology: Run rate of NEAR-captured revenue. Not a forecast.

label: DefiLlama fee and revenue definitions for NEAR Intents
methodology: Adapter methodology text published by DefiLlama, stored verbatim after sanitization. Treated as a third-party claim.

label: NEAR held by buybacks.multisignature.near
methodology: Native NEAR balance plus wNEAR balance of the buyback multisig, read at final block. Tokens held here are acquired, not burned; total supply is unchanged unless they are burned.

label: NEAR total supply (protocol)
methodology: total_supply from the final block header.

label: Protocol maximum annual inflation rate
methodology: max_inflation_rate from EXPERIMENTAL_protocol_config. Realized issuance can be lower (it depends on validator uptime).

label: Buyback wallet holdings as share of total supply
methodology: Both values read from the same RPC at nearly the same block.

label: Maximum annual issuance at current price
methodology: Upper bound on new tokens per year valued at today's price, for comparison with buyback demand. Not a measure of sell pressure.

label: Daily active accounts, 30-day mean
transform: mean of daily values over 30 days ending 2026-11-10
methodology: NearBlocks active_accounts (accounts that signed a transaction that day). Accounts are not people: one person or bot can control many accounts, and relayers can sign for many users.

label: Daily active accounts, 30-day mean one year earlier
transform: mean of daily values over 30 days ending 2025-11-10
methodology: Same definition, window ending 365 days earlier.

label: Daily transactions, 30-day mean
transform: mean of daily values over 30 days ending 2026-11-10
methodology: NearBlocks txns per day. Transaction counts include automated and relayed activity.

label: New accounts per day, 30-day mean
transform: mean of daily values over 30 days ending 2026-11-10
methodology: NearBlocks new_accounts. Accounts are not people: one person or bot can control many accounts, and relayers can sign for many users.

label: Daily active accounts, change vs one year earlier
methodology: Matched 30-day windows one year apart, same source and definition.

label: Base-layer transaction fees, 30 days (NearBlocks)
methodology: NearBlocks txn_fee_usd summed over 30 days. Cross-check for DefiLlama chain fees.

label: Retained signer cohorts (BigQuery)
methodology: Monthly cohorts of new signers from bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions (research/sql/05_new_signer_retention.sql). New means no transaction in a lookback period before the window (365 days by default, or full history), and cohorts are followed only for fully observed months.
notes: Not available in live snapshots. Requires Google Cloud credentials and a freshness check, because NEAR Lake (the dataset's upstream) stopped indexing on 2026-03-24.

label: NEAR chain DeFi TVL
methodology: DefiLlama chain TVL (excludes double-counted liquid staking and borrowed assets by default).

label: NEAR chain DeFi TVL one year earlier
methodology: Same series, 365 days earlier.

label: NEAR TVL change vs one year earlier
methodology: USD TVL moves with token prices as well as deposits; part of any change is price, not usage.

label: RHEA Lend TVL on NEAR
methodology: DefiLlama protocol TVL, NEAR chain only. Incentive programs can inflate deposits.

label: RHEA DEX TVL on NEAR
methodology: DefiLlama protocol TVL, NEAR chain only. Incentive programs can inflate deposits.

label: Stablecoin supply on NEAR
methodology: DefiLlama stablecoins: USD-pegged circulating supply on NEAR.

label: NEAR base-layer gas fees, 90 days
transform: sum over 90 days (same window as Intents)
methodology: All transaction (gas) fees paid by users on the NEAR blockchain, fetched from Allium.

label: NEAR gas fees burned, 90 days
methodology: 70% of every gas fee is permanently burned, reducing NEAR supply. The other 30% is paid to contract developers, so only 70% is protocol revenue.

label: Token-level value capture, annualized (burn + Intents buybacks)
methodology: Dollars per year that currently flow to burns or buybacks. Burns reduce supply; buybacks acquire tokens that may be held, so the two are not equivalent.

label: Market cap / annualized token value capture
methodology: A price-to-earnings style multiple on burns plus buybacks. Not comparable with peers that only burn.

label: NEAR chain fees, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama chain fees adapter: All transaction (gas) fees paid by users on the NEAR blockchain, fetched from Allium.

label: NEAR DeFi TVL
transform: daily value at peer window end
methodology: DefiLlama chain TVL on the peer window end date.

label: NEAR DEX volume, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama DEX volume attributed to NEAR. It includes NEAR Intents swaps settled on NEAR, so it overlaps with Intents volume.

label: NEAR market cap / annualized chain fees
methodology: Chain fees only (no app revenue) so all four chains use one definition. Base-layer tokens may carry value that fees do not explain.

label: NEAR market cap / DeFi TVL
methodology: Market cap at fetch time over TVL at the peer window end. TVL definitions vary by chain adapter.

label: Solana chain fees, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama chain fees adapter: Transaction fees paid by users

label: Solana DeFi TVL
transform: daily value at peer window end
methodology: DefiLlama chain TVL on the peer window end date.

label: Solana DEX volume, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama DEX volume attributed to the chain.

label: Solana market cap / annualized chain fees
methodology: Chain fees only (no app revenue) so all four chains use one definition. Base-layer tokens may carry value that fees do not explain.

label: Solana market cap / DeFi TVL
methodology: Market cap at fetch time over TVL at the peer window end. TVL definitions vary by chain adapter.

label: Sui chain fees, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama chain fees adapter: Transaction fees paid by users for executing transactions on the Sui network

label: Sui DeFi TVL
transform: daily value at peer window end
methodology: DefiLlama chain TVL on the peer window end date.

label: Sui DEX volume, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama DEX volume attributed to the chain.

label: Sui market cap / annualized chain fees
methodology: Chain fees only (no app revenue) so all four chains use one definition. Base-layer tokens may carry value that fees do not explain.

label: Sui market cap / DeFi TVL
methodology: Market cap at fetch time over TVL at the peer window end. TVL definitions vary by chain adapter.

label: Avalanche chain fees, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama chain fees adapter: Transaction fees paid by users

label: Avalanche DeFi TVL
transform: daily value at peer window end
methodology: DefiLlama chain TVL on the peer window end date.

label: Avalanche DEX volume, 30 days
transform: sum over the matched 30-day peer window
methodology: DefiLlama DEX volume attributed to the chain.

label: Avalanche market cap / annualized chain fees
methodology: Chain fees only (no app revenue) so all four chains use one definition. Base-layer tokens may carry value that fees do not explain.

label: Avalanche market cap / DeFi TVL
methodology: Market cap at fetch time over TVL at the peer window end. TVL definitions vary by chain adapter.

label: Share of sampled 1Click volume from top 5 referrers
methodology: Recent successful 1Click swaps from the NEAR Intents Explorer API.
notes: Requires a partner JWT (INTENTS_EXPLORER_JWT). Integrator concentration and organic-vs-wash volume remain unknown without it.

label: Median sampled 1Click swap size
methodology: Recent successful 1Click swaps from the NEAR Intents Explorer API.
notes: Requires a partner JWT (INTENTS_EXPLORER_JWT). Integrator concentration and organic-vs-wash volume remain unknown without it.

label: Annual buyback demand at current run rate
transform: V x f x c x b
methodology: Measured run rate times measured fee, capture and buyback shares. Holds all four constant.

label: Annual buyback demand / market cap
transform: (V x f x c x b) / M
methodology: Buyback demand relative to market cap. A buyback is not a burn and does not mechanically raise price by this amount.

label: Annual volume needed for buybacks = 2% of market cap
transform: (y x M) / (f x c x b), y = 0.02 (assumed)
methodology: Volume at which buyback demand would equal a hypothetical 2% of market cap per year, with fee, capture and buyback shares at measured values.

label: Volume multiple needed for 2% of market cap
methodology: How many times today's run rate the volume would need to be.

label: Required f x c x b at today's volume for 2% of market cap
methodology: Reverse calculation: the share of every dollar of volume that would have to become buybacks. Compare with MODEL-CURRENT-TAKE-RATE.

label: Current f x c x b (volume converted to buyback demand)
methodology: Measured share of each volume dollar that becomes buyback demand.

label: social.near: peak transactions per month (2023-08)
methodology: NearBlocks transactions per month for social.near, per calendar month, exact months only. SocialDB contract behind NEAR Social and BOS components. Newer near.social storage paths are not included. 31 months (2023-09 to 2026-03) were NearBlocks estimates, not counts, and are excluded.

label: social.near: transactions per month, latest complete month (2026-10)
methodology: Same measure for the most recent complete month. SocialDB contract behind NEAR Social and BOS components. Newer near.social storage paths are not included. 31 months (2023-09 to 2026-03) were NearBlocks estimates, not counts, and are excluded.

label: social.near: latest month as a share of its peak
methodology: Retention against the era's own peak over exact months. "Lasted" if at least 25% and the peak is 3+ months old; a more recent peak is not judgeable yet. Transactions are not people; relayers and node traffic are included. 31 months (2023-09 to 2026-03) were NearBlocks estimates, not counts, and are excluded.

label: v1.signer: peak transactions per month (2026-05)
methodology: NearBlocks transactions per month for v1.signer, per calendar month, exact months only. Chain Signatures MPC contract (created 2024-07-31, mainnet 2024-08-08). Counts include MPC node response transactions, not only user sign requests. 21 months (2024-07 to 2026-03) were NearBlocks estimates, not counts, and are excluded.

label: v1.signer: transactions per month, latest complete month (2026-10)
methodology: Same measure for the most recent complete month. Chain Signatures MPC contract (created 2024-07-31, mainnet 2024-08-08). Counts include MPC node response transactions, not only user sign requests. 21 months (2024-07 to 2026-03) were NearBlocks estimates, not counts, and are excluded.

label: v1.signer: latest month as a share of its peak
methodology: Retention against the era's own peak over exact months. "Lasted" if at least 25% and the peak is 3+ months old; a more recent peak is not judgeable yet. Transactions are not people; relayers and node traffic are included. 21 months (2024-07 to 2026-03) were NearBlocks estimates, not counts, and are excluded.

label: intents.near: peak swap volume per month (USD) (2026-09)
methodology: DefiLlama swap volume per month (USD) for intents.near, per calendar month, exact months only. NEAR Intents swap volume from DefiLlama, whose coverage starts on 2024-12-10, a month after the beta launch. Volume is used instead of intents.near transaction counts, which mix relayer and solver batching with use and are NearBlocks estimates before April 2026.

label: intents.near: swap volume per month (USD), latest complete month (2026-10)
methodology: Same measure for the most recent complete month. NEAR Intents swap volume from DefiLlama, whose coverage starts on 2024-12-10, a month after the beta launch. Volume is used instead of intents.near transaction counts, which mix relayer and solver batching with use and are NearBlocks estimates before April 2026.

label: intents.near: latest month as a share of its peak
methodology: Retention against the era's own peak over exact months. "Lasted" if at least 25% and the peak is 3+ months old; a more recent peak is not judgeable yet. Transactions are not people; relayers and node traffic are included.

label: Blockchain Operating System (BOS): NEAR minus BTC return, 90 days after February 2023
methodology: Market context only, not scored: price can move ahead of adoption for good reasons. Returns from daily closes at the pivot date and 90 days later.

label: Blockchain Operating System (BOS): change in daily active accounts, days 60-90 after vs 30 days before
methodology: Context only, not scored: chain-wide activity cannot be attributed to one product. Mean NearBlocks active_accounts over days +60..+90 against the 30 days before the announcement. Accounts are not people.

label: Blockchain Operating System (BOS): social.near activity two months after its mainnet launch month vs the launch month
methodology: Scored. Monthly social.near from exact data: the month two months after the launch month divided by the launch month (or the first exact month, if exact data starts within one month of launch). Adoption followed if at least 2x. A launch month that starts mid-month makes the test easier to pass, not harder. N/A when the launch months are only available as estimates.

label: Chain Signatures: NEAR minus BTC return, 90 days after 27 March 2024 (announced; mainnet 8 August 2024)
methodology: Market context only, not scored: price can move ahead of adoption for good reasons. Returns from daily closes at the pivot date and 90 days later.

label: Chain Signatures: change in daily active accounts, days 60-90 after vs 30 days before
methodology: Context only, not scored: chain-wide activity cannot be attributed to one product. Mean NearBlocks active_accounts over days +60..+90 against the 30 days before the announcement. Accounts are not people.

label: Chain Signatures: v1.signer activity two months after its mainnet launch month vs the launch month
methodology: Scored. Monthly v1.signer from exact data: the month two months after the launch month divided by the launch month (or the first exact month, if exact data starts within one month of launch). Adoption followed if at least 2x. A launch month that starts mid-month makes the test easier to pass, not harder. N/A when the launch months are only available as estimates.
notes: Exact data for the launch month or two months later is not available (estimates only).

label: User-Owned AI: NEAR minus BTC return, 90 days after 22 May 2024
methodology: Market context only, not scored: price can move ahead of adoption for good reasons. Returns from daily closes at the pivot date and 90 days later.

label: User-Owned AI: change in daily active accounts, days 60-90 after vs 30 days before
methodology: Context only, not scored: chain-wide activity cannot be attributed to one product. Mean NearBlocks active_accounts over days +60..+90 against the 30 days before the announcement. Accounts are not people.

label: NEAR Intents (beta): NEAR minus BTC return, 90 days after 10 November 2024
methodology: Market context only, not scored: price can move ahead of adoption for good reasons. Returns from daily closes at the pivot date and 90 days later.

label: NEAR Intents (beta): change in daily active accounts, days 60-90 after vs 30 days before
methodology: Context only, not scored: chain-wide activity cannot be attributed to one product. Mean NearBlocks active_accounts over days +60..+90 against the 30 days before the announcement. Accounts are not people.

label: NEAR Intents (beta): intents.near volume activity two months after its mainnet launch month vs the launch month
methodology: Scored. Monthly intents.near volume from exact data: the month two months after the launch month divided by the launch month (or the first exact month, if exact data starts within one month of launch). Adoption followed if at least 2x. A launch month that starts mid-month makes the test easier to pass, not harder. N/A when the launch months are only available as estimates.

label: Realized net new NEAR supply, annualized
methodology: Change in NearBlocks total_supply over 90 days, annualized. Net of burns; bought-back tokens that are held stay in supply.

label: Realized net new supply per year at today's price
transform: net new NEAR x 365/90 x price
methodology: Annualized net new tokens valued at the current price.

label: Annual Intents volume at which buyback-designated revenue equals the value of realized net new supply
methodology: Supply parity in dollars, not tokens: bought-back NEAR is held, not burned, so even at this volume total supply keeps growing. Assumes the current fee rate, capture and buyback share.

label: Parity volume as a multiple of today's Intents volume run rate
methodology: How far today's volume is from dollar parity with realized net new supply.

label: Buyback-designated Intents revenue since DefiLlama began classifying it (2026-02-23)
methodology: Sum of DefiLlama dailyHoldersRevenue for NEAR Intents from its first non-zero day. This is revenue designated for buybacks by DefiLlama's classification, not verified executed purchases.

label: Buyback wallet holdings at today's price vs cumulative buyback-designated revenue
methodology: Onchain cross-check of executed buybacks. The wallet balance (buybacks.multisignature.near) is what has actually been bought and is still held. Valued at today's price, not purchase prices, and it can include transfers, so it is a sanity check, not a reconciliation of individual trades.

label: Buyback-designated revenue as a share of realized net new supply
methodology: Annualized Intents buybacks divided by the dollar value of annualized net new supply. Paying the token if at least 50%; not paying below 25%. Buybacks are held, not burned.

label: Burns plus buybacks as a share of maximum issuance
methodology: Upper-bound denominator (protocol maximum inflation), so this understates coverage. Shown next to the realized measure for comparison.

label: Spot DEX volume, 90-day run rate (DefiLlama "Dexs" category)
methodology: Per-protocol DefiLlama DEX volume summed per day over protocols in the "Dexs" category only. Excludes prediction markets, bridges (including NEAR Intents), launchpads and trading apps that DefiLlama also lists in its DEX overview.

label: Spot DEX volume, last 365 days
methodology: Same definition, trailing 365 complete days.

label: Everything in DefiLlama's DEX overview, 90-day run rate
methodology: All categories, shown only to document the difference from the spot definition. Not used as a denominator.

label: NEAR Intents volume relative to spot DEX volume, run rate
methodology: Intents 90-day run rate / spot DEX 90-day run rate, same end date. A scale reference: Intents is a cross-chain category and some of its swaps route through DEXs.

label: NEAR Intents volume relative to spot DEX volume, last 365 days
methodology: Trailing-year volumes, same end date.

label: NEAR Intents share of the cross-chain protocols in DefiLlama's DEX overview
transform: Intents run rate / cross-chain category run rate
methodology: Denominator: DefiLlama categories Bridge and Cross Chain Bridge in the DEX overview (10 protocols). Coverage is incomplete: major cross-chain protocols are tracked elsewhere or not at all, so this overstates Intents' share of cross-chain execution.

label: NEAR Intents volume, latest 30 days vs the same 30 days a year earlier
methodology: Momentum today. It is observed; it is not assumed to continue.

label: Spot DEX volume, compound annual growth 2021 to 2025
methodology: Calendar-year spot DEX volume, 2025 versus 2021, annualized over four years.

label: NEAR value reaching holders, 90-day run rate (gas burned + Intents revenue designated for buybacks)
methodology: DefiLlama holders revenue for the NEAR chain (70% of gas, burned) plus NEAR Intents (revenue designated for NEAR buybacks), the same metric used for every peer. Designated, not yet reconciled with executed onchain purchases.

label: NEAR gas burned, 90-day run rate
methodology: 70% of every NEAR gas fee is burned (DefiLlama revenue and holders revenue for the NEAR chain are identical).

label: Intents revenue designated for NEAR buybacks, 90-day run rate
methodology: DefiLlama holders revenue for NEAR Intents; buybacks began 2026-02-23.

label: NEAR value reaching holders, last 365 days
methodology: Same channels, trailing year. The 90-day run rate is the primary basis because NEAR's buyback mechanism started on 2026-02-23; trailing-year multiples are shown for every asset as a check.

label: Intents revenue designated for buybacks per dollar of volume
methodology: Intents holders revenue / Intents volume, same 90 days. Equals take rate x buyback share on the same window.

label: NEAR supply in ten years at the current 2.5% maximum issuance
methodology: Protocol maximum inflation today; realized issuance has been close to the cap.

label: NEAR supply in ten years if HSP-029 takes effect
transform: 2.5% for ~3 months, linear to 1.6% over 24 months, then 1.6%
methodology: Approved by House of Stake on 2026-11-02; linear cut over 24 months after a ~90-day buffer; needs validator adoption and can be vetoed until 2026-11-16.

label: Valuation multiple: Priced like Hyperliquid (market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate)
methodology: Hyperliquid market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate. Used as an assumption for 2036, not a forecast.

label: Valuation multiple: Priced like Hyperliquid, trailing 365 days
transform: market cap / holders revenue over 365 days
methodology: Check on the trailing-year basis. The 90-day run rate is the primary basis because NEAR's buyback mechanism started on 2026-02-23; trailing-year multiples are shown for every asset as a check.

label: Valuation multiple: Priced like Tron (market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate)
methodology: Tron market cap / holders revenue (TRX burned), 90-day run rate. Used as an assumption for 2036, not a forecast.

label: Valuation multiple: Priced like Tron, trailing 365 days
transform: market cap / holders revenue over 365 days
methodology: Check on the trailing-year basis. The 90-day run rate is the primary basis because NEAR's buyback mechanism started on 2026-02-23; trailing-year multiples are shown for every asset as a check.

label: Valuation multiple: NEAR's multiple today (market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate)
methodology: NEAR market cap / (gas burned + Intents revenue designated for buybacks), 90-day run rate. Used as an assumption for 2036, not a forecast.

label: Valuation multiple: NEAR's multiple today, trailing 365 days
transform: market cap / holders revenue over 365 days
methodology: Check on the trailing-year basis. The 90-day run rate is the primary basis because NEAR's buyback mechanism started on 2026-02-23; trailing-year multiples are shown for every asset as a check.

label: Ethereum: market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate (platform)
methodology: Context for the two valuation regimes. Platform tokens are valued on their on-chain economy, not on this ratio.

label: BNB: market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate (platform)
methodology: Context for the two valuation regimes. Platform tokens are valued on their on-chain economy, not on this ratio.

label: Solana: market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate (platform)
methodology: Context for the two valuation regimes. Platform tokens are valued on their on-chain economy, not on this ratio.

label: Tron: market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate (cash-flow)
methodology: Context for the two valuation regimes. Platform tokens are valued on their on-chain economy, not on this ratio.

label: Hyperliquid: market cap / holders revenue, 90-day run rate (cash-flow)
methodology: Context for the two valuation regimes. Platform tokens are valued on their on-chain economy, not on this ratio.

label: Market cap at $10 in ten years (2.5% issuance)
methodology: Price x projected supply.

label: $10: rank among today's crypto assets at that market cap (stablecoins excluded)
methodology: Position against today's largest 40 assets by market cap; stablecoins and wrapped or tokenized assets excluded.

label: $10: Intents annual volume needed (Priced like Hyperliquid)
methodology: Market cap / multiple = value to holders needed; minus burns held at today's run rate; divided by Intents holders revenue per dollar of volume.

label: $10: Intents volume relative to 2036 spot DEX volume (Priced like Hyperliquid)
methodology: Required volume / spot DEX run rate grown 20% a year for ten years (assumption).

label: $10: Intents growth needed every year for ten years (Priced like Hyperliquid)
methodology: Required volume / today's run rate, annualized over ten years.

label: $10: Intents annual volume needed (Priced like Tron)
methodology: Market cap / multiple = value to holders needed; minus burns held at today's run rate; divided by Intents holders revenue per dollar of volume.

label: $10: Intents volume relative to 2036 spot DEX volume (Priced like Tron)
methodology: Required volume / spot DEX run rate grown 20% a year for ten years (assumption).

label: $10: Intents growth needed every year for ten years (Priced like Tron)
methodology: Required volume / today's run rate, annualized over ten years.

label: $10: Intents annual volume needed (NEAR's multiple today)
methodology: Market cap / multiple = value to holders needed; minus burns held at today's run rate; divided by Intents holders revenue per dollar of volume.

label: $10: Intents volume relative to 2036 spot DEX volume (NEAR's multiple today)
methodology: Required volume / spot DEX run rate grown 20% a year for ten years (assumption).

label: $10: Intents growth needed every year for ten years (NEAR's multiple today)
methodology: Required volume / today's run rate, annualized over ten years.

label: $10: stablecoins on NEAR at Ethereum's market cap to stablecoins ratio
methodology: Platform framework: rung market cap / benchmark (market cap / stablecoins on chain). Not a cash flow; never added to the cash-flow framework.

label: $10: DeFi TVL on NEAR at Ethereum's market cap to TVL ratio
